assumptions: The repository is accessible and contains the specified Python scripts.
Standard scientific Python stack (matplotlib, pandas, scipy, scikit-learn) will be available for installation.
Scripts are designed to run standalone via `python <script>` without external data dependencies beyond standard libraries or internal mocks.
constraints: Do not invent files or CLI IDs outside this exploration.
Results must adhere to the directory pattern: YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS__{benchmark_slug}__{method_slug}__seed-{seed}.
Metrics filenames must be metrics.csv and logs.txt within result directories.
missing_context: Some source excerpts were truncated to fit the Planner context budget.
Specific dataset availability for certain evaluators is not explicitly confirmed in provided snippets (assumed internal or mocked).
Script tunables (dataset/method) were not scraped; confirm in-file defaults.
results_summary_path assumes repo creates summary.json; if not, Engineer will report 0 metrics captured unless per-row result artifacts under matrix results_path are readable.
setup phase rewritten to avoid venv-in-plan pattern; uses bare pip/python. Engineer creates a workspace-mounted .venv at runtime so installs persist across Docker containers.
verification_checks: entrypoint exists for each kept run_command
CLI flags documented in entrypoint argparse (when flags used)
manual OrderedDict / # set edits demoted to missing_context
risks: Experimental modules may raise warnings (e.g., ExperimentalWarning) which are expected but should be logged.
Serial execution of multiple scripts may take significant time depending on internal trial counts.
In-file OrderedDict edits are required when scripts expose no CLI flags.
organization: Setup -> Smoke Test -> Serial Experiments -> Aggregation
Each experiment phase depends on the previous one completing successfully (exit_code 0).
engineer_notes: Prefer compact axes + a few example matrix rows (run_command/code_refs/verify).
Record dataset availability gaps in missing_context if scripts fail due to data issues.
